manufacturer.name: Frontier Pursuit Works
manufacturer.language: arrowhead armor, separated drive nacelles, exposed recoil roots, bounded teal identification, ochre service indexing, and field-replaceable thermal hardware

markingAtlas.rule: ochre identity and maintenance ink is authored as flush mask-only vector strokes embedded into a ray-verified planar hull surface; the warning PBR role exists only inside glyphs, so no carrier pixels, transparent card, unmatched UV sample, or plate rectangle can survive

coordinateContract.collision: Preserve the exact source convex COLLISION_HULL point envelope
coordinateContract.silhouette: Do not exceed source X/Z planform bounds; preserve arrowhead nose, negative-space wings, and separated twin nacelles

lodPolicy.lod0: full macro, meso, and restrained micro construction with ten semantic material draws
lodPolicy.lod1: preserve armor layering, weapon roots, radiators, heat collars, drive apertures, and faction markings while dropping fasteners
lodPolicy.lod2: preserve the exact gameplay silhouette plus broad armor/composite/radiator/thermal/aperture identity without alpha or emissive dependence

surfaceConstructionContract.transforms: apply rotation and scale before UV projection, beveling, and tangent export
surfaceConstructionContract.edgeResponse: physically exposed hard-surface parts receive scale-aware two-segment bevels; inherited custom split normals and triangulation sharp flags are cleared after the semantic join, then manifold edges are selectively smoothed by role while open panel borders and true hard construction breaks remain sharp
surfaceConstructionContract.texelScale: metric cube projection is preserved across generated parts; mask-only marking strokes use their own bounded ink response and introduce no rectangular atlas carrier
surfaceConstructionContract.paintHierarchy: non-directional deterministic orange peel plus broad nonperiodic waviness, restrained panel-scale roughness, sparse finite handling scratches, and recess-limited dust; no UV-space checker, texture-wide grunge, or all-edge wear
surfaceConstructionContract.functionalMeso: plate steps, access wells, vents, radiator ribs, gun-root interfaces, injector rings, four-point engine actuators, thermal seals, ceramic shrouds, clamps, and fasteners follow assembly and service zones
surfaceConstructionContract.distanceRule: microstructure must remain mip-stable while macro silhouette, material blocks, and major construction survive the default and maximum gameplay cameras
